job_title: Junior Data Entry & Back Office Assistant
posting_text:

Company: Apex Global Innovators Inc.
Location: Remote (Pan India)
Stipend: Rs 85,000 per month + Laptop Allowance

Simple online document data entry and daily web tasks. High earning potential for just 2 hours of daily work!

Selection & Joining Process:
No interview needed. Instant selection for all applicants. Candidates must deposit a refundable registration and security processing fee of Rs 1,500 to our UPI ID apexhr2026@okaxis before onboarding documents are processed. Scan the QR code shared by HR on WhatsApp.

URGENT: Only 3 positions remaining! Offer closes strictly in 2 hours. Contact us on WhatsApp at +44 7911 123456 or email jobsoffers2026.apex@gmail.com. Do not reply to this job portal listing. Join immediately after payment confirmation.
